Clinical Implementation Specialist (RN)
Quillfield Health
Location: Remote (US)
Employment type: Full-time

About Quillfield Health

Quillfield Health is a whole-person virtual care company. We work with health systems, health plans, employers and individuals to make care easier to get, from urgent care and primary care to chronic condition management and mental health. Our hospital and health system solutions bring virtual care into the places clinicians already work: telehealth carts and devices in patient rooms, virtual sitting, virtual nursing, and connected specialty consults.

About the role

Our Hospital & Health System Implementation team gets new client programs live and working. As a Clinical Implementation Specialist, you'll be the clinical voice on the implementation team for hospital customers launching virtual care programs, such as virtual nursing, virtual sitting and tele-critical care. You'll partner with a project manager and a technical implementation engineer, and you'll own the clinical side: workflow design, training, go-live support and the first 90 days of adoption.

This role is for a nurse who has lived through a go-live from the unit side and knows what makes bedside staff adopt a new tool, or quietly work around it.

What you'll do

- Lead clinical discovery sessions with nursing leaders, unit managers and frontline staff to understand current-state workflows for admissions, discharges, patient observation and rounding.
- Design future-state workflows that define what the virtual clinician owns and what the bedside clinician owns, and document them in clear workflow maps and role guides.
- Build and deliver training for client nurses, charge nurses and virtual staff, including train-the-trainer and super-user programs.
- Provide on-site and remote go-live support, including at-the-elbow support on units during launch weeks.
- Track and triage go-live issues; separate training gaps from configuration problems and route them to the right team.
- Define adoption and outcome measures with the client (for example virtual admission completion, discharge education completion, time to discharge) and review them with client leadership at 30, 60 and 90 days.
- Feed what you learn from the field back to our product and clinical teams.
- Keep implementation plans, risks and decisions up to date in our project tools.

What you bring

- Active, unrestricted RN license (compact license preferred).
- 5+ years of acute care nursing experience; critical care, step-down or med-surg strongly preferred.
- Experience with at least one EHR implementation, upgrade or major optimization, as a super-user, trainer, informatics nurse or project team member.
- Experience teaching adults, such as precepting, unit education, super-user training or classroom training.
- Comfort leading meetings with nurse managers and directors and holding your ground on workflow decisions.
- Strong organization: you can run several client launches at different stages without dropping details.
- Working comfort with spreadsheets and basic data; you can build a tracker and summarize what it shows.

Nice to have

- Charge nurse or other unit leadership experience.
- Experience with virtual nursing, virtual sitting, tele-ICU or other telehealth programs.
- Familiarity with Epic or Oracle Health (Cerner) inpatient workflows.
- Data analytics coursework or experience with SQL, Looker, Tableau or similar.
- Quality improvement project experience (falls, sepsis, CLABSI, CAUTI or similar).

Travel

This role travels to client sites for discovery and go-live, up to 20% on average. Travel is concentrated around launches; some months will have none.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $98,000 to $124,000 per year. Placement in the range depends on experience and location. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus and our benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off and paid parental leave.

Work authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.
